headline: Single-cell and spatial methods add plausibility metrics and identifiability-aware dynamics models
label: Spatial Quantification And Identifiability
summary: Nine preprints from early November 2026 pair spatial and single-cell dynamics inference with explicit checks on what the data can identify or validate.
synthesis: The dominant thread is quantification that states what a model can recover and tests it. BioTrajX scores pseudotime trajectories with Directionality, Order Consistency and Endpoint Validity metrics. The decidualization study separates temporal delay from amplitude attenuation using identifiability-aware models, simulations and GEO re-analysis. CytoBridge infers continuous virtual dynamics from spatial snapshots with an unbalanced mean-field Schrodinger bridge, and SPECHTacle combines Waddington optimal transport with Shannon entropy. CRISP and MorphoANOVA relate signals across modalities, probabilistically or through nested spatially varying coefficient models linking H&E morphology to expression. scCircaSim supplies simulated ground truth with known phases and rhythm parameters. MIST and BEHAV3D-Explorer extend this to single-molecule and 3D microscopy dynamics.
